title: Work With Us
description: Join our therapy practice in Princeton MA near Worcester. Licensed therapist positions with competitive pay, flexible hours, benefits, 401k. Hiring counselors now.

sections.heading: Building a community of care—one connection at a time.
sections.intro: At Moving Mountains Counseling & Wellness, we're building a team of skilled, compassionate clinicians who share our vision: therapy should feel human, supportive, and accessible. If you're looking for a place to practice your craft, collaborate, and make a real impact, we'd love to meet you.
